items.title: DaVita (NYSE:DVA) Beats Q2 CY2026 Sales Expectations But Stock Drops
items.summary: Dialysis provider DaVita Inc. (NYSE:DVA) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 5.2% year on year to $3.55 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $4.02 per share was 3.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
